# Spanish (`es`) style for graph overlays

Overlay file: `src/data/graph.es.json`.

- Natural, internationally understandable editorial Spanish; preserve every factual qualification.
- Use standard Spanish instrument and place names when established (violonchelo, Nueva Orleans).
- Preserve artist, track, label and festival proper names. Use established genre names; lowercase them in prose (jazz, rock alternativo, house).
- Use Spanish punctuation and accents, sentence case for titles, and curly quotes where appropriate.
- Dates: `1 de agosto de 1981`, `década de 1980`, `siglo XVIII`; BCE is `a. e. c.`.
- Translate editorial confidence as `confianza`, not statistical probability. Distinguish descent (`deriva de`), influence and historical context.
